plan.name: Use Microwave to Heat Mug
plan.strategy: Locate a mug, heat it in the microwave, and place it in the coffeemachine.
steps: Find a mug in one of the cabinets, drawers, or on the countertops.
Take the mug to the microwave.
Put the mug in the microwave and heat it.
Remove the heated mug from the microwave.
Place the heated mug into the coffeemachine.
